blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Mindoro State University’s Victoria Main Campus ranked first nationwide among top-performing schools in the secondary level of the September 2026 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers (LEPT), after posting a 100 percent passing rate. Based on results published by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), MinSU’s College of Teacher Education led the category for institutions with 50 to 99 examinees and at least a 90 percent passing rate. University officials commended the newly licensed professional teachers, faculty mentors, and the entire academic community for the milestone, noting that the achievement underscores MinSU’s commitment to quality teacher education and […]...
